answer: Each epoch the registry auctions 400 meadow harbor berths, one per identity; sealed bids set the 400th-bid price. Every bid is backed by a jade tally: winners lock bids as bond, losers refunded, each berth binds one key. A rented-berth ring fails audit and burns the bond; the wharf manifest lists holders. Honest traders bid 46 credits, so 1,000 fakes pay 46,000 for berths earning nothing, while an honest trader pays 46 once, keeping the income.
